visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair tied back is sitting indoors, speaking directly to the camera with an expressive face. She is wearing a grey t-shirt with a cartoon cat graphic. The lighting is bright and even. (2) She stands in a modern kitchen with a black refrigerator. She opens the fridge door, looks inside with a hesitant expression, then closes it and walks away, gesturing toward her stomach as if considering her weight. (3) A sequence shows her at home with a toddler in a white onesie; she appears to be exercising or moving around. Close-up shots of a plate with grilled meat, eggs, and sweet potatoes are shown. (4) A smartphone screen is displayed showing a Chinese text search result about hunger, muscle loss, and metabolism. (5) The woman reappears, looking surprised with a lightbulb icon overlay near her head. She then holds up two yellow and pink bags of Quaker granola products. (6) Detailed close-up shots of the Quaker Daily Satisfaction Protein Granola packaging are shown, highlighting '3x Protein' and natural ingredients like oats, nuts, and dried fruit. (7) She is seen eating the granola from a white bowl with a spoon, looking satisfied. A man with glasses is also shown eating and giving a thumbs-up. (8) A young child is seen eating the granola from a pink bowl. The woman is shown preparing the granola by pouring milk into a bowl and mixing it with yogurt in another scene. (9) Final shot of the woman holding three different flavored bags of the product, smiling and gesturing at the camera in a kitchen setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking in an enthusiastic, narrative tone over a bright, mid-tempo electronic pop BGM. The voice is clear and prominently mixed in the center. (2) A mechanical sound of a refrigerator door opening is heard, followed by a soft thud as it closes. The narrator's tone becomes more thoughtful and questioning. (3) A sharp 'ding' sound effect occurs, signaling an epiphany or 'lightbulb' moment. The BGM continues with a steady, rhythmic beat. (4) Distinct, high-frequency 'crunch' sound effects are introduced as the narrator describes the granola. The sound of dry cereal being poured into a ceramic bowl creates a percussive, cascading texture. (5) A splashing sound follows as milk is poured. The vocal track maintains a high energy level, occasionally punctuated by small cartoonish 'pop' sound effects during visual transitions. (6) A child's voice briefly giggles in the background. The music reaches a slight swell towards the end with a final brand slogan delivered clearly by the female narrator, followed by a quick audio fade-out.
